modern Vietnamese restaurant in a 5-star hotel
Apr 2026 • Business
Rice Paper truly impressed me, from the beautiful ambiance to the outstanding quality of the food. The Vietnamese menu is incredibly diverse and beautifully presented, yet the flavors remain comforting and authentic. Even though it's a newly opened restaurant, everything runs seamlessly. The atmosphere is upscale and sophisticated, yet warm and inviting—perfect for both family gatherings and hosting business guests. The staff are super friendly and attentive. I will definitely be back many times! I came there April and May many times because I worked in Phu Nhuan ward . I save some photos from their social media as I forgot to take photos.
